stateFormation.priority: Ordinary first; switching path or interruption restarts the corresponding saved window.

honors.required: Existing living kin of current royal house, actual active military appointment and verified capture career; issuer in-country sovereign with at least twelve months reign.
honors.ZHENGUOGONG: At least two distinct captured cities including an actual enemy capital.
honors.honorCandidateWeight: Only an existing legal candidate with actual current royal command evidence; honors do not add battle credits or confer armies; existing total candidate ceiling remains 50%.

courtAttempts.opportunity: Original qualified annual country deposition boundary with real recent national crisis, existing vulnerability, eligible adult kin and existing 60-month cooldown. One original shared draw, no per-general draw.
courtAttempts.actor: Verified active permanent military person, actual office, at least two real command members, twelve months service, willingness and ambition greater than live loyalty.
courtAttempts.success: Original successful deposition interval and original weighted legal candidate selection; original success probabilities unchanged.
courtAttempts.failure: Actual command dismissal and disbanding, no fabricated execution or revoked honors.
courtAttempts.population: Failed attempts add no bodies. Successful normal royal accession may establish the existing legal royal as one audited RULER entity through the original lifecycle, never a new ordinary resident or formation. The royal-military personal-success fixture reuses the exact old body with zero population increase.
courtAttempts.calibrationConclusion: All three groups have one qualified instigator opportunity in 400 world-years and zero actual attempts. They share the same four seeds and are not twelve independent seeds. 40-100 world-years per major attempt has NOT been demonstrated; no further sample chasing or forced outcomes.

funnel.qualificationScope: Session since load; event totals are recorded-world-history counts.
funnel.limitation: The paired run does not retain the primary sub-blocker for each of those 32 opportunities; no numerical attribution to a particular army/personality condition is claimed.

natural.sameSeedSupplement: Only baseline regional-3 replayed to obtain the omitted formation-event count; exact original canonical fingerprint matched. It is not an extra independent sample.
natural.laterChanges: Frozen success-pressure and explicit consequence references, malformed-input rejection, read-only display and tests; no later political decision/probability/RNG rules changed. Natural samples contain no court attempts.
